key_insight: LOKI discovers row-level joins between disjoint tables by using sentences as evidence, turning implicit text-table links into explicit, typed integration paths.
engineering_relevance: This enables data-lake integration of heterogeneous tables without predefined schemas or joins, making discovery-driven data integration more scalable and interpretable.
method: Builds contextual representations of table rows and sentences with horizontal bidirectional cross-attention.
Uses a global table-text contrastive objective to surface fine-grained row-sentence matches without local supervision.
Clusters discovered associations into relation-consistent groups and materializes typed integrated tables with sentence provenance.
evidence_signal: On real-world benchmarks, LOKI outperforms prior multi-modal discovery methods and achieves 0.982 macro typed-pair precision, while being up to 40x cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.
watch_item: Performance depends on the availability and quality of supporting text, and discovered join paths may still require human review in ambiguous or noisy corpora.
paper_title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
